name: Miss U More
description: A passive +/- indicator for the one person you miss. No notifications — just a badge.
_comment_gecko_id: Firefox requires an explicit add-on id for MV3 (there's no pinned-key mechanism like Chrome's). missu@glimpsed.io uses our own domain in reverse-DNS-ish form, which AMO accepts as an opaque string; it just needs to stay stable and unique, which it is.
_comment_data_collection: AMO (2025+) requires an explicit data-collection declaration under gecko. The extension collects nothing: it reads the SPA's own session token from localStorage locally to render a count and talks only to the user's own missu.fyi API. 'none' is the accurate declaration.
_comment_background: Firefox's MV3 support for the event-page-style service_worker is inconsistent across versions; the non-persistent background *page* (scripts array) is the well-supported path there, so we branch the manifest instead of the code. background.js itself is written against the browser.* promise API and doesn't care which host loads it.
